highlights.reason_zh: 暂停与冷恢复直接改变长时程 coding agent 的故障处理，但仍需真实副作用回归。
highlights.reason_en: Parking and cold recovery directly change long-running coding-agent failure handling, but real side effects still need regression tests.

highlights.reason_zh: 开放数据、权重和加速方案让文档解析质量与吞吐可以在目标材料上复测。
highlights.reason_en: Open data, weights and a speed path make document-extraction quality and throughput testable on target material.

highlights.reason_zh: FlashInfer 代码已有实际部署结果，可能降低 Blackwell 世界模型服务延迟，但质量证据仍窄。
highlights.reason_en: Merged FlashInfer code has deployment results that may cut Blackwell world-model latency, with narrow quality evidence.

highlights.reason_zh: 大样本轨迹分析提醒团队：测试通过并不自动证明 agent 的每处代码改动都必要。
highlights.reason_en: A large trajectory analysis warns that passing tests does not prove every coding-agent change is necessary.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开 AMD 看板和工作流可直接用于 llama.cpp 性能回归，硬件范围也清楚可见。
highlights.reason_en: A public AMD dashboard and workflows directly support llama.cpp regression checks with visible hardware limits.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取成功并完成阅读；主动补充开源推理、文档 AI、编程 agent 评测、agent 安全、小团队、非英语材料和重大综合新闻检查。Qwen、NVIDIA 与 Hugging Face 主张仍缺完整独立复现；两项日期精度不足的变更未按小时窗口入库。本轮无重大综合新闻例外。 召回自检补录 Raon-1 mini、GRH Lean 短证明与 llm.asm，并保留独立验证限制。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and fully read. Active discovery added open-source inference, document AI, coding-agent evaluation, agent security, small teams, non-English sources and an exceptional general-news check. Qwen, NVIDIA and Hugging Face claims still lack full independent reproduction; two date-only changes were not admitted into the hourly window. No exceptional general-news item qualified. The recall audit recovered Raon-1 mini, the shorter GRH Lean proof and llm.asm with independent-validation limits preserved.
